title: Forcing a Letter Suppresses Refusal: Mechanistic Evidence from WMDP
abstract: arXiv:2611.08639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) commonly use multiple-choice question (MCQ) format. However, prior studies documented that MCQ format reduces refusal rates, which may significantly affect the safety behavior of the model. We provide a first mechanistic explanation of this effect on the Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP) dataset across two models - Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B. First, we use the tuned lens technique to show that when processing MCQ the model commits to an answer-letter token very quickly, which is in contrast to the gradual refusal build-up in open-ended formats. Additionally, we observe that activations on the MCQ format lie roughly 3x further from the refusal direction, compared with their open-ended counterparts. translated_title: 强制选择字母抑制拒答：来自WMDP数据集的机制性证据
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的安全基准通常采用多项选择题（MCQ）格式。然而，先前的研究表明，MCQ格式会降低模型的拒答率，这可能显著影响模型的安全行为。我们在大规模杀伤性武器代理数据集（WMDP）上，针对两个模型——Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen3-8B——首次提供了对这一效应的机制性解释。首先，我们使用调优透镜（tuned lens）技术表明，在处理MCQ时，模型会非常迅速地提交到某个答案字母token，这与开放式格式中拒答逐步建立的过程形成鲜明对比。此外，我们观察到MCQ格式下的激活与拒答方向的距离大约是开放式格式下的3倍。而且，消融承载MCQ格式答案的注意力头会增加拒答，这直接证明了MCQ的答案选择过程与拒答过程之间存在竞争。这些发现……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文首次从机制层面解释了多项选择题（MCQ）格式为何会抑制LLM的拒答：模型会过早地锁定答案字母，其内部激活显著远离拒答方向，且消融承载答案的注意力头会使拒答回升，证明答案选择与拒答存在直接竞争。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first mechanistic evidence that MCQ formats suppress LLM refusal: models rapidly commit to an answer-letter token, their activations lie roughly 3x farther from the refusal direction, and ablating the attention heads carrying the MCQ answer increases refusal, showing that answer selection directly competes with refusal.
